title: Grafana
subtitle: Unified dashboards, queries and alerts across metrics, logs and traces.

tiles.label: Metrics source
tiles.detail: Time-series panels, variables and annotations turn metrics into understanding.

tiles.label: Logs source
tiles.detail: Logs sit beside metrics, so a spike links to its cause with one click.

tiles.label: Traces source
tiles.says: Grafana queries Tempo for distributed traces.
tiles.detail: Trace-to-log and trace-to-metric links shorten incident triage.

tiles.label: Dashboards
tiles.says: Dashboards compose panels from many sources.
tiles.detail: Template variables let one dashboard serve every service and environment.

tiles.label: Explore
tiles.says: Explore runs ad-hoc queries during incidents.
tiles.detail: Engineers pivot between metrics, logs and traces without building a dashboard first.

tiles.label: Provisioning
tiles.says: Dashboards and datasources load from files in Git.
tiles.detail: Dashboards as code are reviewed, versioned and reproducible.

tiles.label: Unified alerting
tiles.says: Alert rules query any source and track state.
tiles.detail: Normal, pending and firing states drive notification policies with labels.

tiles.label: Contact points
tiles.says: Contact points deliver alerts to email, chat or webhooks.
tiles.detail: Routing by label sends each team its own signals.

tiles.label: Teams & RBAC
tiles.says: Roles and folder permissions control access.
tiles.detail: SSO integration keeps access aligned with the organisation.

declarations: Grafana visualises; it does not store metrics.
One pane for metrics, logs and traces.
Alert on what the dashboard proves.
